name: Eternal Hall (1-2) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
description: Time distorts along this hallway, making the air feel like sludge.
disable: DC 17 Thievery (trained) to disrupt the temporal distortions, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 16) to disperse the temporal energy

generalAbilities.name: Time Press
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the hall

Effect Time weighs upon the creature, dealing (2d6+5) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw save). On a critical failure, the creature is Slowed 1 for 1 round.
